steps.content: ▌▌error▌▌,▌▌,▌▌▌purge...
▌▌error▌▌,▌▌,▌▌▌purge...
You manage to hold off the enemy in front of you with your shackles, but the more you use your power, the more it attracts the enemy's attention. It's like a never-ending vicious cycle.
No wonder 000 was so cautious back then, taking so long to plan killing even a duck. You decide to stop fighting and avoid trouble for now.
I warned you, didn't I? The realm of gods doesn't allow Mania to run wild. Be careful when using your power. If you're discovered and deemed a system error, even I can't save you.
Hmm? You're asking why I'm so adept?
I've always been a bug, hunted in every world I'm in. I learned my skills after countless chases. I'll teach you a few tricks next time.
If she were here, she'd definitely say that. In the face of adversity, you do miss that reckless, carefree little lunatic.
Although you can't learn her mindset, you can always borrow some past experiences. Think about how 000 used to "shield" you intruders...
You force your way into a device. The intense rejection almost expels you; there's no Game 5732 here.
Fortunately, you're no longer the panicked traveler you once were. You've gained the residual power of the Dark Web Ghost. Time to use it...
<color=#ffffff><size=50>Game 5732 downloaded and installed!<color=#ffffff></size>
The intense rejection finally stops. You hide in the game, avoiding pesky pursuits, but you haven't fully recovered yet.
At this moment, a notification suddenly buzzes within the game.

<color=#fb9259>[RiSe]</color>: I'm Rise. Finally found you.
<color=#fb9259>[RiSe]</color>: Those ducks... no, those permission holders... are having a meeting to find the mole.
<color=#fb9259>[RiSe]</color>: You need those developer permissions, right? This is a good opportunity.
<color=#fb9259>[RiSe]</color>: I'll help you.
In the realm of dreams.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Just trap them in a dream for now, right?
Wind screams, whipping sand into a biting haze as the open-top vehicle tears across the desert.

options: Yes, but it won't be easy.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Understood. Though I can't use Nightmare's power, there are many "people" here who will help me.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They understand the "nightmares in this world" better.
Behind her, a group of blurry figures gather. They speak in incomprehensible tongues, all seemingly eager and ready.
[Scene Change] Duck Conference Room
...Quack... Quack quack quack!
Quack quack... Quack quack...

<color=#fb9259>[RiSe]</color>: Everything's ready. Go ahead, Chief Bug.
<color=#fb9259>[RiSe]</color>: Let's see how much you can shake things up.
